start: Import routines screen, the paste step 'Copy your routines from Hevy', a Hevy folder link copied in Hevy (Share Folder → Copy Link)

steps.action: Paste 'https://hevy.com/folder/177335' into the box (hint 'hevy.com/folder/…') and tap Read link
must_not: The Read link button works while the box is empty
A Hevy sign-in page is shown

steps.action: Wait for the read to finish
user_sees: The folder's routines, each with a tick
'Copied exactly as saved in Hevy: warm-ups, sets, reps and rest.'
must_not: A routine missing from the list with no word about it
Warm-up sets counted as working sets

steps.action: Tap 'Check these 4' and go through each routine with Next
user_sees: Each routine's exercises ticked, 'As saved in Hevy. Untick anything you don’t want.'
'Sets, warm-ups, reps and rest are as saved in Hevy. You can change them later in the routine.'
must_not: An exercise that appears twice in Hevy shown only once
Back loses the ticks already changed

steps.action: On 'Follow these as your plan?' tap 'Follow them'
must_not: The routines saved twice
The member's current plan changed when they chose not to follow

start: Import routines screen, paste step; a single routine shared from Hevy (Share Routine → Copy Link)

steps.action: Paste a message 'Check out my routine https://hevy.com/routine/AbC12' and tap Read link
must_not: 'That isn’t a Hevy share link…' for a message that holds a real link

steps.action: Finish the read and the check step
user_sees: 'Your plan only changes if you pick it. A routine of the same name there is updated, not doubled.'
must_not: A second copy of a routine of the same name in that folder
'1 routines'
The plan the member follows changed without being picked

user_sees: 'That isn’t a Hevy share link. It looks like hevy.com/folder/… or hevy.com/routine/…'
must_not: The hidden reader starts for a link that is not Hevy's
An empty list of routines

steps.action: Paste a Hevy folder link that was deleted in Hevy and tap Read link
user_sees: 'Hevy says this link does not exist any more. Copy it again from Hevy.'
must_not: An endless 'Reading your Hevy link…'
A folder with no routines saved

steps.action: Turn the internet off and tap Read link again
user_sees: 'We couldn’t open that link. Check your internet and try again.' or 'Hevy took too long to answer. Check your internet and try again.'
must_not: A crash
A success card

start: A folder copied from a Hevy link last week; the member since changed the sets of one exercise in 'Push 1'

steps.action: Paste the same folder link again and tap Read link, then Next through the check
must_not: The routines shown as new copies

user_sees: 'This updates the routines in “<folder>”. Anything you changed in them yourself is kept.'
must_not: No word that the folder will be updated

user_sees: ' Your own changes to Push 1 were kept.'
must_not: The member's changed sets replaced by Hevy's
An exercise the member deleted coming back
The folder doubled

steps.action: Read a folder where only part of the page came in
user_sees: 'Only 4 of 6 routines could be read — try again'
must_not: The part read saved as if it were the whole folder without a choice

start: Import routines screen, paste step, member signed in to MettleUp

steps.action: Paste a Hevy folder link and tap Read link
must_not: The member's Hevy password or key asked for or stored
The link sent to the gym or to MettleUp's server

steps.action: Save the routines and open Workout → Routines
user_sees: The routines on this phone only, in the member's own folder
must_not: The routines shown to the gym or to gym mates without the member sharing them
The member's followed plan changed unless they picked it
